tashkent.name: Tashkent
tashkent.intro: A leafy capital of broad avenues, lively markets, and contemporary Uzbek life.
tashkent.seasonNote: Milder weather makes city walks and day trips more comfortable.
tashkent.transport: Use the metro for major districts, agree on taxi fares in advance or use a ride app, and leave extra time for cross-town traffic.
tashkent.etiquette: Be considerate around religious sites and ask permission before photographing people or inside sacred spaces.

samarkand.name: Samarkand
samarkand.intro: A historic Silk Road city known for monumental architecture, craft traditions, and lively streets.
samarkand.seasonNote: Spring and autumn are comfortable for walking between the old city landmarks.
samarkand.transport: Many central sights are close together. Use a licensed taxi for longer distances and confirm the destination before setting off.
samarkand.etiquette: Choose modest clothing when visiting religious places and follow posted guidance about entry and photography.

bukhara.name: Bukhara
bukhara.intro: A walkable old town of trading domes, courtyards, and centuries of living history.
bukhara.seasonNote: Cooler days are best for exploring the old town on foot.
bukhara.transport: The old town is compact. Wear comfortable shoes on uneven lanes and arrange a taxi for sights outside the center.
bukhara.etiquette: Some historic sites remain places of worship. Keep voices low and ask before taking close-up photos.

khiva.name: Khiva
khiva.intro: A walled inner city of tiled gates, quiet lanes, and artisan workshops.
khiva.seasonNote: Spring and autumn bring gentler temperatures for the exposed inner-city walkways.
khiva.transport: Itchan Kala is best explored on foot. Plan water and shade breaks, and use a taxi for the longer trip to or from the station.
khiva.etiquette: Ask before photographing artisans at work, and agree on prices before commissioning or buying handmade goods.

Toolkit.title: Travel smarter in Uzbekistan
Toolkit.subtitle: Practical local tips, useful phrases and everyday planning tools.
Toolkit.metroBody: Use the metro for quick trips around Tashkent. Check current routes, hours and payment options before travelling.
Toolkit.trainsBody: Afrosiyob is the high-speed service on key city routes; Sharq and other services connect more destinations. Check schedules and passport details on the official ticket site.
Toolkit.taxiBody: Confirm your destination and fare in the app before the ride. For street taxis, agree on the fare before getting in.
Toolkit.intercityBody: Compare train and shared-car options, confirm the station and departure time, and keep your passport details consistent with your ticket.
Toolkit.phrasebookBody: 40 practical phrases with copy and device speech support.
Toolkit.currencyBody: Editable sample rates for planning only. Check a current rate before exchanging money.
Toolkit.priceBody: Indicative seeded ranges only. Actual prices vary by season, venue and negotiation.
Toolkit.travelDocsBody: Requirements depend on nationality, trip purpose and length. Verify your situation with official sources before travel.
Toolkit.visaAnswer: Visa-free access varies by passport and permitted stay. If you need a visa, apply through the official e-visa portal. TODO_VERIFY
Toolkit.registrationQuestion: Do I need to register my stay?
Toolkit.registrationAnswer: Accommodation providers may handle guest registration. Confirm who is responsible and the current deadline with an official source. TODO_VERIFY
Toolkit.govInfo: Official visa and foreign visitor information
Toolkit.seasonSpring: Spring · layers, light rain jacket, comfortable walking shoes and sun protection.
Toolkit.seasonSummer: Summer · breathable clothes, hat, sunscreen, refillable water bottle and light layers for evenings.
Toolkit.seasonAutumn: Autumn · layers, comfortable shoes and a light jacket for cooler evenings.
Toolkit.seasonWinter: Winter · warm coat, layers, gloves and shoes with good grip.
Toolkit.etiquetteBody: Small courtesies help make visits more comfortable. Customs vary by place and person.
Toolkit.etiquettePrayer: Ask before photographing people, especially during prayer or at religious sites.
Toolkit.etiquetteShoes: Follow signs and hosts’ guidance about removing shoes indoors.
Toolkit.etiquetteGreetings: Greet people politely; a respectful hello and thanks go a long way.
Toolkit.etiquetteHospitality: Hospitality is often important. Accept or decline offers graciously.
Toolkit.etiquettePhotos: Dress modestly when visiting religious places and follow posted rules.
Toolkit.etiquetteDress: Ask permission before entering private or sacred areas.
